🗳️🇲🇽 <u>SOMOS MÉXICO, PARTY OF THE "PINK TIDE," ORDERED TO REBRAND BY THE INE</u>

The party founded by the "el INE no se toca" crowd just got reined in by... the INE. Mexico's electoral institute gave Somos México until August 30 to change its name, logo and color, ruling the name is no neutral label but "a composition of words with semantic and pragmatic weight" that suggests the party speaks for the entire nation — and that its MX emblem "induces the belief" of state backing. The party, whose ranks include ex-INE officials and detained ex-governor Ernesto Ruffo as counselor, says it is open to an audit of its financing.

🌳🇲🇽 "More than 6 million trees planted, 1.7 million seeds sown directly, and half a million more dispersed by drone — over 32,000 hectares in a single day." — Columba López Gutiérrez, Agriculture Secretary, Puebla Over 241,000 people joined across all 32 states — Semarnat, Agriculture, Welfare, the Army, Navy and National Guard planting side by side. Native species matched to each ecosystem: pines and oyameles here, mangroves on the coasts, mezquite in the north.
banner: 6M TREES IN ONE DAY, ALL 32 STATES

text: 🌱🇲🇽 "Martí said it: whoever plants a tree changes history — and changes himself. The second Sunday of August is now National Reforestation Day, every year." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, San Nicolás de los Ranchos, Puebla Sheinbaum signed the decree onstage. Sembrando Vida, launched 8 years ago under AMLO, has planted over 1.5 billion trees with 400,000+ sembradoras y sembradores. The new pledge: 1.5 billion more plants by 2030 — from the deserts to the jungle.
banner: "HE WHO PLANTS A TREE CHANGES HISTORY"

text: 🇲🇽✊ "I propose we stop calling this territory 'Paso de Cortés' — the peoples passed through here long before. Today, on the International Day of Indigenous Peoples, let us call it 'El Paso de los Pueblos Indígenas'." — President Claudia Sheinbaum, Izta-Popo pass, Puebla The pass between the Popocatépetl and Iztaccíhuatl volcanoes has been called "Paso de Cortés" since 1519, when Cortés crossed it toward Tenochtitlán after the Cholula massacre. Sheinbaum announced the renaming at the launch of National Reforestation Day in Santiago Xalitzintla.

🇲🇽🌳 1.2 billion trees planted in eight years — today, 6.6 million more in a single day. Sembrando Vida has planted 1.2 billion timber and fruit trees and reforested over 1 million hectares in eight years. The stakes, per Environment Secretary Alicia Bárcena: Mexico holds 12% of the world's biodiversity, and 60% of its forest ecosystems are in ejido and community hands. Deforestation, illegal logging, fires and pests hit over 1.1 million hectares a year — illegal logging is now fought in coordination with the Security Secretariat. — Jornada Nacional de Reforestación, Izta-Popo National Park, Puebla, August 9, 2026
